description: e-nexus task intake: only the receiver's routes (2026-11-10). Replace <HOSTNAME>. Human creates it in the dashboard or with the API.
expression: (http.host eq "<HOSTNAME>") and not ((http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/mcp" "/ack" "/status"}) or (http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path in {"/pull" "/mcp"}))
